name: The Oxtail Factory
tagline: Oxtails, fried chicken and peach cobbler on West Brown Street.
about: The Oxtail Factory at 919 W Brown St is a soul food spot built around oxtails.
Plates come with a choice of rice, mac and cheese, mashed potatoes, yams, green beans, collard greens or black-eyed peas. Diners mention big portions, fair prices and friendly staff.
